added care and signing-authority checks for customers without procurement support
excluded: the first-sale conversation with a prospect, which belongs to the market and lease-sales knowledge base
legal advice on the agreement
assessment of a customer's financial capacity, which is the funder's credit process

pros.claim: Conduct rules make the renewal survivable for the customer's trust even when the commercial answer is a new long term
pros.example: an office manager who signs a new agreement able to state its length, its notice date and what happens at the end without looking it up

pros.claim: Insisting on like-for-like comparison from the customer's own invoices removes the most common source of later resentment
pros.example: a comparison built from twelve months of the customer's actual service and lease invoices rather than from an estimated current cost

cons.claim: Slower, fuller conversations lengthen the cycle and lose deals to competitors who simply push
cons.example: a customer who signs with a rival during the reading time this process deliberately gave them

cons.claim: Care standards are hard to evidence and can become a checkbox that changes nothing about how the meeting actually felt
cons.example: a signed acknowledgement of terms collected in the same breath as the signature

failure_modes: using end-of-support language that no manufacturer notice supports
comparing a new agreement against a list price rather than against the customer's real current spend
obtaining a signature from someone without authority at a small organization
acceptance_tests: the file shows a like-for-like comparison built from the customer's own invoices, a written plain-language term summary delivered before signature, and reading time recorded between delivery and signing
signing authority is confirmed and recorded, and any claim about support or end of life is backed by the manufacturer notice it came from
revisit_triggers: a complaint or cancellation cites pressure or surprise at the terms
manufacturer lifecycle notices change what may be claimed
the standard term summary or proposal format is revised

base.update_signal: a complaint, cancellation or audit citing pressure or surprise, or a change in manufacturer lifecycle notices that alters permissible claims

nodes.definition: Treat the physical return as a commercial event with its own cost exposure, because this is where an agreement that ended amicably turns into a surprise invoice. The work runs on the return window the schedule specifies: schedule deinstallation inside it; account for every accessory, finisher, cabinet, tray and cable the original delivery included, since missing components are commonly chargeable; prepare the unit to the condition the funder's return terms require, including packing and palletizing where specified; ship to the location the funder names rather than to the convenient one, and retain proof of delivery, because a device that cannot be proved delivered can be billed as unreturned; take and record a dated final meter at removal so the last service invoice is real and the device stops billing; reconcile any on-site consumable stock; and check the funder's condition or missing-item assessment against the documented state at pickup. The customer is told what the return will cost them and what it requires of them before the option is chosen, not after the truck arrives.

included: return window scheduling, condition and accessory accounting
freight, destination and proof of delivery
dated final meter, stock reconciliation and dispute of condition assessments
excluded: stored-data disposition, which is its own obligation node
the funder's own remarketing or disposal of the returned asset
the installation of any replacement device, which belongs to the deployment knowledge base

pros.claim: Documenting condition and delivery removes the dealer's and the customer's exposure to end-of-term charges nobody expected
pros.example: a photographed, itemized pickup record that defeats a missing-finisher assessment weeks later

pros.claim: A dated final meter at removal closes the service billing cleanly and prevents the classic ghost invoice
pros.example: a removed device that stops appearing on the billing run because its removal read and date were captured at pickup

cons.claim: Return logistics consume real labour and freight on an account that is by definition no longer generating an annuity
cons.example: a multi-device removal across several floors of a municipal building at the end of a term that will not be renewed

cons.claim: Condition standards are the funder's to interpret, so even a well-documented return can attract charges the dealer can only contest
cons.example: cosmetic damage assessed on a unit the customer used normally for a full term

failure_modes: missing the return window and incurring continued obligations
shipping without proof of delivery and being billed for an unreturned asset
leaving the device on the billing run because no final meter was recorded
acceptance_tests: each return has a dated pickup record with itemized accessories and condition, a proof of delivery to the specified location, and a recorded final meter
the customer received a written statement of return requirements and likely charges before the return option was chosen
revisit_triggers: a funder changes return locations, packing or condition requirements
a condition or missing-item assessment arrives after a return
a return window is at risk of being missed

base.update_signal: a funder revision to return terms, or a pattern of post-return condition assessments against documented pickups

nodes.definition: Recognize that a modern multifunction device is a computer holding customer data - latent images of scanned and copied documents on internal storage, address books, scan-to-folder and scan-to-email credentials, stored jobs, fax logs and network settings - and that none of it may leave the customer's control undealt with. Before any device is returned, swapped, redeployed or disposed of, the stored data is handled by a documented method appropriate to the device and the agreement: running the device's own overwrite or sanitization function, removing the storage and leaving it with the customer where the agreement and the funder's terms allow, or arranging certified destruction; and the customer receives a dated record of what was done to which serial. The obligation class is named rather than invented: general data-protection duties, sector confidentiality duties in health, legal, financial, education and public-sector environments, the customer's own contractual and internal policies, and any procurement condition attached to a public lessee. Specific standards, retention rules and notification duties differ by jurisdiction and by sector and must be verified in your jurisdiction; where a customer's obligations are unclear, they are directed to their own advisors rather than reassured.

included: the classes of data a device retains
documented disposition methods and the dated record given to the customer
naming the obligation class with a verify-locally instruction
excluded: security hardening and configuration of devices in service, which is an engineering task
advising a customer on whether they meet their own regulatory duties
asserting that a particular standard or method is legally required anywhere

pros.claim: A documented turnover record protects the customer, the dealer and the funder at the moment of highest exposure and is often the first thing a regulated customer asks about
pros.example: a clinic asking, before agreeing to a swap, what happens to the images on the outgoing machine and receiving a dated certificate for the serial

pros.claim: Making disposition part of the removal plan prevents the pattern where a device leaves and the question is asked afterwards
pros.example: a school unit collected on a Friday with the sanitization step already scheduled and evidenced

cons.claim: Sanitization takes technician time and sometimes device downtime at exactly the point where everyone wants the unit gone
cons.example: an overwrite routine that occupies a machine for hours on removal day

cons.claim: Capability varies by model and age, so a uniform promise cannot be made across a mixed base
cons.example: an older unit whose available functions do not match what a newer model can evidence

failure_modes: removing a device before its storage has been dealt with because the truck was already booked
promising a specific standard or outcome the device or the program cannot evidence
treating a redeployment between customers as lower risk than a return
acceptance_tests: no device leaves a customer site without a recorded disposition method, a serial-level dated record and, where applicable, the customer's acceptance of the method
the obligation classes are named in the customer-facing record with the instruction to verify current requirements in their jurisdiction and sector
revisit_triggers: data-protection or sector rules relevant to a customer class change
a device model with different storage capability enters the base
a customer or their auditor requests evidence of past turnovers

base.update_signal: a change in data-protection or sector confidentiality requirements, or a new device generation with different storage and sanitization capability

nodes.definition: Step back periodically and read the base as one asset, using mechanisms and directional bands rather than invented benchmarks. The quantities that matter are all computable from what the business already records: how many agreements reached term end and how many stayed, expressed as a retention trend rather than a target; total billed clicks across the base and their direction, separated into mono and colour; realized service margin by model family and by account cohort; the concentration of term ends by quarter; the share of the base currently past a notice deadline or running on an automatic renewal; dispute rate and credit value as a proportion of billing; and the count of devices in the chronic and loss bands. The purpose is to see structural decay that no individual account review can show - a model family whose parts cost has risen against its installed rates, a customer segment whose pages are migrating to portals and shared drives, a cohort of agreements whose compounded uplifts have moved them out of the market - and to convert those findings into changes in what the dealer places, prices, and schedules rather than into commentary.

included: portfolio trends and bands computed from the dealer's own records
detection of structural decay across model families, cohorts and segments
conversion of findings into placement, pricing and scheduling changes
excluded: market sizing and segment targeting, which belong to the market knowledge base
any published benchmark or industry-average figure presented as a fact
individual account remedies, which belong to the device and account nodes

pros.claim: Portfolio reading catches decay that account-level work cannot see because it spans accounts
pros.example: a model family whose service margin has fallen across every account holding it, pointing at parts cost rather than at any one customer

pros.claim: Expiry concentration and automatic-renewal share are early warnings about both revenue risk and disclosure exposure
pros.example: a quarter carrying a disproportionate share of term ends alongside a rising count of agreements already rolled

cons.claim: Aggregates flatten the individual accounts that actually decide renewals and can license inaction on specific problems
cons.example: a stable blended margin masking two large accounts drifting in opposite directions

cons.claim: Without observed benchmarks, portfolio bands are internal and directional only, so they answer whether the base is moving but not whether it is competitive
cons.example: an improving retention trend that still lags what a rival is achieving in the same territory

failure_modes: importing an outside benchmark figure and treating it as this base's target
producing the review as a report nobody converts into placement, pricing or scheduling changes
reading blended margin without separating mono and colour or model families
acceptance_tests: every reported quantity is computed from the dealer's own records with its window and definition stated, and no external benchmark is asserted as a fact
each structural finding carries a named change to placement, pricing, service or calendar practice with an owner
revisit_triggers: a model family or cohort trend breaks its established direction
expiry concentration or automatic-renewal share moves materially
cost inputs across the base change

base.update_signal: a trend break in a model family, cohort or segment, or a material shift in expiry concentration or automatic-renewal share

nodes.definition: Close the renewal cycle with a definition of done, because the failure mode here is a signed order that leaves the annuity restarting blind. The closing set is specific: the new schedule signed by a person whose authority was confirmed, with the plain-language term summary acknowledged and the reading time recorded; funder acceptance received where a new lease is involved; the disposition of the outgoing device decided, scheduled and linked to its data-turnover record; a dated final meter and a final invoice closing the outgoing agreement with any on-site consumable stock reconciled; the ledger updated with the new schedule number, term end, notice basis, rate structure, counter families and billing contact, and the old row closed rather than overwritten; and a briefing to the deployment team carrying the meter history and the configuration reasoning behind the sizing, so that installation continues the account's data rather than starting a new baseline from nothing. Until every element exists, the renewal is open, whatever the order says.

included: the closing checklist for a renewal
ledger update and closure of the outgoing agreement row
the briefing handed to deployment including meter history and sizing reasoning
excluded: the physical installation, network integration and user setup that follow, which belong to the deployment knowledge base
funder credit decisioning
commission and compensation processing

pros.claim: A definition of done keeps the next term from beginning with a broken meter baseline and an unbilled outgoing device
pros.example: a replacement installed with the outgoing unit's final read recorded, so the first invoice of the new term reconciles cleanly

pros.claim: Passing the sizing reasoning forward stops the deployment team from re-deciding configuration on the day and undoing the evidence work
pros.example: an installer who knows the smaller device was chosen deliberately from two years of the account's own volume

cons.claim: The checklist slows the point at which an order can be celebrated and reported, which creates internal pressure to declare completion early
cons.example: an order booked while the outgoing device's data turnover is still unscheduled

cons.claim: It depends on other teams delivering records the renewal owner does not control
cons.example: waiting on a funder acceptance before the ledger can be closed and reopened cleanly

failure_modes: overwriting the ledger row so the account's history disappears
closing the renewal before the outgoing device's disposition and data turnover are scheduled
handing over an order without the meter history that justified the configuration
acceptance_tests: every element of the closing set exists and is dated before the renewal is recorded as complete, including the outgoing device disposition and its data-turnover link
the deployment briefing contains the account's meter history and the reasoning behind the sizing decision
revisit_triggers: the deployment team reports missing history or contradictory configuration reasoning
a funder or program changes what acceptance requires
an audit finds renewals recorded complete with elements missing

base.update_signal: an audit of completed renewals against the closing set, or a change in what funder or deployment acceptance requires

edges.why_related: the register exists to hold the per-device annuity the frame defines as the unit of account
the disclosure doctrine is scoped by which streams and obligations the customer actually carries under the frame
you cannot defend a read without knowing which serial, which counter families and which agreement it belongs to
the billing run consumes verified dated reads as its quantity input
the dispute protocol investigates invoices the run produced and reads its evidence trail
an uplift is applied inside the run and is only meaningful against the structure the run implements
realized margin per click is the quantitative expression of the spread the annuity frame identifies
supply control targets the consumable component the margin decomposition isolates
call cost management targets the labour and parts components the margin decomposition isolates
per-serial profit and loss needs shipments attributed to serials before it can classify a device
per-serial profit and loss needs labour, travel and parts attributed to serials
response and restore performance is produced by the same dispatch, remote-resolution and parts practices that set call cost
service performance per account is the largest single input to the churn watchlist
the forward renewal queue is generated from the term ends and notice bases held in the register
notice monitoring and reminders are the notice-critical band of the calendar made operational
the option analysis is the work the decision band of the calendar triggers
the device's own profit and service history is evidence the upgrade, extend and buyout comparison requires
sizing and rating the next term only begins once the option has been chosen on evidence
return logistics execute the return option and their cost must be known while the option is still being compared
stored-data disposition is scheduled inside the removal plan rather than after the device has moved
the doctrine converts the customer's notice deadline from dealer advantage into a disclosure obligation with a delivery test
the absorbed remaining obligation is exactly the class of fact the doctrine requires to be shown before signature
conduct rules are the doctrine applied to the room where the renewal is actually decided
the closing set cannot be completed while an outgoing device's stored data has no documented disposition
collecting a contracted uplift on schedule pulls against giving the customer advance warning that lets them question or resist it
edges.resolution_rule: the doctrine wins: an uplift is applied only after a dated notice quoting the clause has been delivered ahead of the invoice, and a missed notice defers the uplift to a later cycle rather than being applied retroactively

edges.why_related: telling a customer their own deadline invites the competitive process the renewal pipeline would rather avoid
edges.resolution_rule: disclosure dominates pipeline protection: the reminder is always sent to a verified decision-maker in writing, and the renewal is defended with service evidence and honest options rather than with the customer's ignorance of a date

edges.why_related: the dispatch that restores a customer fastest is rarely the dispatch that costs least, and call-reduction levers can shade into under-serving
edges.resolution_rule: downtime on a device the customer cannot work without dominates call-cost control; chronic units are escalated to a full parts kit, substitution or manufacturer escalation rather than absorbed as repeat visits, and any deferral of a rated preventive interval is a recorded decision

edges.why_related: the early upgrade is the most lucrative renewal outcome and the one whose economics are hardest to present without pressure
edges.resolution_rule: conduct dominates the transaction: no roll proceeds without the funder's written payoff figure shown, the new term length stated beside the payment, a recorded customer need it serves, and reading time given; absent any of these the roll is refused rather than reframed

edges.why_related: a device or account known to be unprofitable creates pressure to recover margin by specifying a larger machine or a higher base volume than the evidence supports
edges.resolution_rule: evidenced volume caps configuration and allowances absolutely; margin is recovered through cost control, a swap to a better-suited model, or an openly negotiated rate at a contractual point, and never by oversizing or by a base volume set above evidenced usage

edges.why_related: lean supply control removes the cupboard of spares that customers rely on to avoid a run-out at the worst moment
edges.resolution_rule: keep forecast-driven replenishment as the default but agree an emergency path in writing with the account, and never let stock discipline cause an outage on a device identified as critical

edges.why_related: rising coverage and a heavier colour share directly raise delivered consumable cost per page and compress the contracted spread
supply leaving a site without corresponding clicks raises realized consumable cost per page regardless of how the rate was quoted
an unresolved or badly handled dispute is one of the most reliable precursors of a lost renewal
root-cause classification of disputes tells the operator which collection paths and counter configurations are actually failing
portfolio findings on expiry concentration and automatic-renewal share re-sequence when calendar work starts and where capacity goes
closing a renewal writes the new schedule, dates, notice basis and rate structure back into the register that starts the next cycle
the sizing and rating decision must be complete and evidenced before the closing set can record it and brief deployment
both read the same cost, click and service data, one at serial granularity for action and one at portfolio granularity for structural decay

conflict_axes.name: disclosure_duty_vs_pipeline_protection
conflict_axes.description: Telling a customer their notice deadline, their uplift and the remaining obligation absorbed into an upgrade is the trade's core integrity test, and each disclosure measurably increases the chance the account shops or declines.
poles: disclose early, in writing, unprompted
protect the renewal by staying quiet until asked
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclosure is not tradeable; the renewal is defended with uptime evidence, honest options and the account's own data rather than with a date the customer never saw

conflict_axes.name: service_speed_vs_delivered_service_cost
conflict_axes.description: The response that protects the customer's working day and the dispatch pattern that protects margin per click pull in opposite directions on every chronic device.
poles: restore fast whatever the visit costs
minimize calls and travel per thousand clicks
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: protect uptime on identified critical devices and convert chronic units into escalation and swap decisions instead of absorbing repeat visits as cost

conflict_axes.name: evidenced_capacity_vs_placement_economics
conflict_axes.description: A larger or faster device and a higher base volume improve the placement and the overage line, while the account's own billed history often justifies something smaller.
poles: size to what the account could grow into
size to what the meter history evidences
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: billed history caps configuration and allowances; growth is accommodated by contractual mechanisms rather than by hardware bought in advance of evidence

conflict_axes.name: upgrade_revenue_vs_customer_need
conflict_axes.description: The early upgrade with remaining payments absorbed is the most profitable renewal outcome and the one most likely to serve the dealer rather than the account.
poles: roll the account into a new term now
let the current term run and step the payment down
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: require a recorded need, the funder's written payoff figure and the new term length shown beside the payment; refuse repeated rolls inside one term

conflict_axes.name: supply_availability_vs_leakage_control
conflict_axes.description: Customers want spare cartridges on the shelf and the dealer needs every consumable to correspond to clicks that were billed.
poles: ship generously so nobody ever runs out
ship to forecast and reconcile every cartridge
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: forecast-driven replenishment with a written emergency path, plus shipment-to-click reconciliation per serial so exceptions are investigated rather than assumed

conflict_axes.name: billing_certainty_vs_meter_reality
conflict_axes.description: Invoicing must go out on a cycle while meter collection fails silently on some devices in every period, which forces a choice between an estimate and a delay.
poles: bill the cycle on time with an estimate
hold the device until a verified read exists
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: estimate only where the contract and the customer have been told, label it on the invoice, and true it up against the next verified read rather than stacking estimates

conflict_axes.name: rate_defence_vs_relationship_repair
conflict_axes.description: Holding a contracted overage line protects margin and the precedent, while crediting quickly protects the account through a moment that decides its next renewal.
poles: defend the contracted charge
credit and repair the relationship
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: credit where the dealer's own evidence is the weaker one and say so plainly, then correct the structural cause so the same credit is not owed twice

conflict_axes.name: uplift_collection_vs_market_competitiveness
conflict_axes.description: Applying every contracted uplift maximizes the stream on aged agreements and steadily moves those rates away from what the same account could obtain elsewhere.
poles: apply the mechanism every anniversary
hold rates to keep the agreement defensible at term end
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: apply only with notice and test aged cohorts against what the dealer would quote today, recording any waiver or deferral as a decision with a reason

conflict_axes.name: account_rescue_vs_portfolio_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Individual accounts justify carrying loss-making devices for relationship reasons while the book needs those exceptions to stay rare and visible.
poles: carry the device to protect the account
act on every device in the loss band
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: allow carried losses only as recorded decisions with a reason, an owner and a review date, and report their count and value in the portfolio review

conflict_axes.name: closing_speed_vs_customer_comprehension
conflict_axes.description: Renewals compete against a notice deadline and an internal reporting period, while a customer without procurement support needs time and repetition to understand what they are signing.
poles: close inside the window and the quarter
give reading time and check understanding
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: start the cycle earlier in the long-lead band so comprehension never has to be traded against the deadline, and record reading time between delivering the term summary and taking a signature

edge_cases.description: A site's collection agent stops reporting after a firewall or subnet change and three cycles are billed on estimates before anyone notices
edge_cases.trigger: silent loss of automatic meter collection at a customer site
edge_cases.mitigation: run a no-read exception report every cycle, label estimated periods on the invoice, restore collection or obtain a technician read, and true up the whole estimated span against the first verified read

edge_cases.description: A controller board is replaced under service and the device's counters restart from zero in the middle of a billing period
edge_cases.trigger: a counter reset caused by a board, storage or whole-device replacement
edge_cases.mitigation: bridge the period from the technician's recorded removal read and the swap paperwork, bill the reconstructed clicks with the method noted on the account, and never invoice the raw difference across the reset

edge_cases.description: A customer disputes colour charges because pages carrying a single coloured logo are counted as colour clicks
edge_cases.trigger: counter-family behaviour that surprises the customer after months of billing
edge_cases.mitigation: explain the counter behaviour against the signed agreement, check the device profile matches the contracted families, and offer the remedies that exist such as driver defaults or a review at a contractual point rather than a silent re-rate

edge_cases.description: The lease schedule and the service agreement carry different end dates, so equipment is returned while the service contract keeps renewing on a device that has left the building
edge_cases.trigger: misaligned lease and service terms discovered at end of term
edge_cases.mitigation: hold both dates per serial in the register, work the earlier one, and terminate or align the service agreement as part of the disposition rather than after the first orphan invoice

edge_cases.description: The notice reminder is delivered to a contact who left the organization months earlier and the agreement rolls automatically
edge_cases.trigger: contact turnover between the last review and the notice window
edge_cases.mitigation: verify decision-maker and notice address at every review and before every reminder, require an acknowledgement, and where a roll occurred without a delivered reminder pursue an unwind in good faith and record the outcome

edge_cases.description: An account's volume collapses mid-term when it closes a location or moves a workflow to a portal, leaving it far below a contracted minimum
edge_cases.trigger: a structural volume event during the term
edge_cases.mitigation: state plainly what the agreement provides and what it does not, bring forward the review to the earliest contractual point, and present redeployment, consolidation or an early honest option analysis rather than silently invoicing the shortfall until term end

edge_cases.description: Weeks after a return, the funder assesses charges for a missing finisher and cosmetic condition that nobody documented at pickup
edge_cases.trigger: an end-of-term condition or missing-item assessment on a returned asset
edge_cases.mitigation: photograph and itemize accessories and condition at pickup, keep proof of delivery to the specified location, contest the assessment with that record, and tell customers the return requirements before the return option is chosen

edge_cases.description: A device is collected on the day it is scheduled and its internal storage still holds scanned images and scan-to-email credentials
edge_cases.trigger: removal logistics running ahead of the stored-data disposition step
edge_cases.mitigation: make a recorded disposition method a precondition of movement for every serial, schedule sanitization with the removal, and give the customer a dated record naming what was done and the obligation classes they should verify locally

edge_cases.description: A competitor requests the account's meter history and copies of the agreement, and the customer asks the dealer for their own data
edge_cases.trigger: an inbound competitive assessment on an account inside the base
edge_cases.mitigation: provide the customer's own meter and billing history promptly and completely, treat the request as a dated churn signal with an owner, and respond with service evidence and an early honest option review rather than with delay or a reflex discount

edge_cases.description: Toner is auto-shipped to a device that is scheduled for swap the following week, and a cupboard of cartridges is left behind when the machine goes
edge_cases.trigger: replenishment running independently of the disposition calendar
edge_cases.mitigation: suspend replenishment for serials with a scheduled disposition, reconcile on-site stock before the device moves, and transfer or recover compatible consumables as part of the closing set

edge_cases.description: An anniversary uplift appears on an invoice although no notice was ever sent for that agreement
edge_cases.trigger: an escalator applied by the billing system without its notice condition satisfied
edge_cases.mitigation: credit the difference immediately, defer the uplift to a cycle after a proper dated notice, and gate the run so no uplift can be applied to an agreement without a recorded delivered notice

edge_cases.description: A public-sector lessee gives notice that funds were not appropriated for the coming period and the agreement ends earlier than the calendar assumed
edge_cases.trigger: a non-appropriation or budget-driven early termination event on a public account
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the clause as read from the specific schedule, move the account immediately into disposition planning with return and data-turnover steps, close the service billing on a dated final meter, and refer the customer and the dealer to the funder and to counsel on the contractual consequences

workflow.action: Fix what the installed base actually earns and who owns each stream
workflow.description: Separate the one-time placement margin, the funder-owned lease stream and the dealer-owned per-page service stream, and name the mechanisms by which the signed spread decays over the term
workflow.artifact: annuity frame statement naming the streams, their owners and the decay drivers for this base
workflow.gate: each stream has an identified owner taken from an actual schedule and the decay drivers are stated as things measurable on this base

workflow.action: Build or reconcile the contract and device register
workflow.description: Transcribe from signed schedules the funder, term end, notice basis, buyout reference, rate structure, counter families, billing contact and last dated meter for every serial
workflow.artifact: per-serial register reconciled against signed documents with an exception list
workflow.gate: every active serial resolves to exactly one agreement row with a term end, a notice basis and a dated last meter, and exceptions are assigned for resolution

workflow.action: Calendar the disclosure duties for the life of each agreement
workflow.description: Turn the disclosure triggers into dated obligations with owners: escalator notice, notice-window reminder, overage pattern restatement, rollover arithmetic and end-of-term cost warning
workflow.artifact: disclosure schedule per account with owners, timing rules and written formats
workflow.gate: each trigger has an owner, a before-the-effect timing rule and a durable written form the customer keeps

workflow.action: Verify meter collection on every device before the cycle runs
workflow.description: Confirm which devices report automatically, chase gaps, obtain technician or customer reads where needed, and reconstruct any counter reset from swap documentation
workflow.artifact: read register for the period with source, date and estimate flags per serial
workflow.gate: no serial enters billing without a read carrying a source and a date, and every estimate is flagged with its true-up plan

workflow.action: Run the billing cycle and reconcile it before it is sent
workflow.description: Compute clicks per counter family from paired dated reads, apply the contracted structure and proration, apply only notified uplifts, and check the exception report
workflow.artifact: reconciled invoice run with an exception report and reproducible invoice presentation
workflow.gate: a sample invoice reproduces end to end from the printed readings and the contracted structure, and the run releases no device billed without a read

workflow.action: Rebuild realized margin per click from actuals
workflow.description: For each device family take actual supply shipments, parts issued, labour and travel booked and freight against billed clicks for the same dated window, separating mono and colour
workflow.artifact: per-device and per-model realized margin reconstruction with its window stated
workflow.gate: every component traces to an actual shipment, issue or booking for that window, with no figure carried from an assumed benchmark

workflow.action: Control consumable flow and dispatch cost, then review each serial
workflow.description: Reconcile shipments to clicks, drive replenishment from forecast, apply remote resolution, first-call fix and rated preventive intervals, then band every serial and assign remedies
workflow.artifact: device banding list with named remedies, owners and review dates
workflow.gate: every device in the loss band has a remedy inside the agreement or an explicit recorded decision to carry it, and no remedy is a service or supply degradation

workflow.action: Manage uptime and work the account health watchlist
workflow.description: Report response and restore per account against contracted terms, escalate chronic devices on their trigger, close incidents with the customer, and act on dated churn signals
workflow.artifact: per-account service report and a dated signal list with owners and action windows
workflow.gate: chronic devices meeting the trigger show a recorded escalation step, and every active churn signal has an owner and an act taken or scheduled

workflow.action: Work the forward expiration calendar in lead bands
workflow.description: Queue every agreement by the earlier of notice deadline and term end, open long-lead reviews, and compare band workload against capacity each period
workflow.artifact: forward renewal queue with bands, owners and a capacity comparison
workflow.gate: no agreement passes its notice deadline without a recorded action, and band overloads are answered by earlier long-lead starts rather than dropped steps

workflow.action: Deliver the notice reminder and manage automatic renewal exposure
workflow.description: Compute the window from the schedule text, send a dated written reminder to a verified decision-maker stating the consequence of the date passing, and pursue unwinds where a reminder failed
workflow.artifact: dated reminder records with acknowledgements and an exception list of rolls
workflow.gate: every agreement approaching its window has a delivered reminder to a verified recipient, and each roll without one carries a recorded unwind attempt and outcome

workflow.action: Present the four end-of-term options and re-rate from billed history
workflow.description: Compare upgrade, extend, buy out and return with the evidence each requires, then size and rate any new term strictly from the account's own dated click history and rebuilt delivered cost
workflow.artifact: option analysis in customer terms plus a sized proposal traced to billed history
workflow.gate: all four options appear with their evidence and per-period cost, funder figures are in writing, and every configuration and allowance traces to dated history at or below evidenced volume

workflow.action: Close the renewal against the definition of done
workflow.description: Collect the signed schedule with confirmed authority and acknowledged term summary, funder acceptance, outgoing device disposition with its data turnover, final meter and invoice, ledger update, and the deployment briefing
workflow.artifact: closed renewal packet with the updated register row and the deployment briefing
workflow.gate: every element of the closing set exists and is dated, with the outgoing device's disposition and data-turnover record linked before the renewal is recorded complete

dominance_rules.rule: Plain prior disclosure dominates the timing of any charge or deadline
dominance_rules.rationale: the durable reputational damage in this trade comes from customers learning about uplifts, rolls and absorbed obligations from an invoice instead of a conversation
dominance_rules.trigger: any change to what the customer pays, or any deadline that binds them, is about to take effect
dominance_rules.action: deliver a dated written explanation in plain language before the effect, and defer the charge rather than apply it without notice

dominance_rules.rule: The customer's notice deadline is disclosed even when silence would renew the agreement
dominance_rules.rationale: an automatic roll obtained through the customer's ignorance of a date is a disclosure failure regardless of what the clause permits
dominance_rules.trigger: an agreement approaches its notice window
dominance_rules.action: send a dated reminder to a verified decision-maker stating the deadline and what happens if it passes, and record the acknowledgement

dominance_rules.rule: A verified read dominates a convenient estimate
dominance_rules.rationale: the meter is the billing quantity, and an unlabelled estimate is an invented number on an invoice
dominance_rules.trigger: a device has no verified read when the cycle is due
dominance_rules.action: hold the device, label any permitted estimate on the invoice, and true up the whole span against the next verified read

dominance_rules.rule: Evidenced volume dominates configuration and allowance preference
dominance_rules.rationale: overselling capacity a customer's own data cannot justify is the failure this subdomain exists to prevent
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposed device, base volume or term exceeds what the account's billed history supports
dominance_rules.action: size down to the evidence and record any customer-stated growth separately rather than building it into hardware or allowances

dominance_rules.rule: The funder's written figure dominates any verbal or system-estimated remaining balance
dominance_rules.rationale: an early upgrade turns on an obligation amount the dealer does not set and cannot approximate honestly
dominance_rules.trigger: a rollover, buyout or payoff amount is needed for a customer conversation
dominance_rules.action: obtain the figure in writing from the funder and show it, with its arithmetic and the resulting term length, before any signature

dominance_rules.rule: Documented data disposition dominates removal scheduling
dominance_rules.rationale: stored images and credentials leaving a customer's control is the one end-of-term failure that cannot be corrected afterwards
dominance_rules.trigger: a device is scheduled to be returned, swapped, redeployed or disposed of
dominance_rules.action: block the movement until a disposition method is recorded for that serial and a dated record is prepared for the customer

dominance_rules.rule: Uptime on a customer-critical device dominates service-cost control
dominance_rules.rationale: the account is retained or lost on the machine it cannot work without, not on the territory's average cost per call
dominance_rules.trigger: a cost-reduction measure would slow response, defer a rated preventive interval or extend an outage on an identified critical device
dominance_rules.action: protect the restore, escalate the chronic unit to kit, substitution or manufacturer escalation, and record any deferral as a decision

dominance_rules.rule: The signed schedule dominates habit, memory and system defaults
dominance_rules.rationale: notice bases, counter families, coverage exclusions and buyout mechanisms differ between schedules on the same account
dominance_rules.trigger: any date, rate, counter or end-of-term mechanism is about to be acted on
dominance_rules.action: read it from the specific schedule and correct the register at source when they disagree

dominance_rules.rule: Root-cause correction dominates closing the ticket with a credit
dominance_rules.rationale: a credit without a correction guarantees the same defect bills again and converts a billing error into a retention problem
dominance_rules.trigger: a dispute is settled by credit or adjustment
dominance_rules.action: record the root-cause class, assign the correction with an owner, and verify non-recurrence in the following cycles

dominance_rules.rule: Contract mechanisms dominate unilateral remedies when margin is under pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: quiet re-rating, slowed dispatch or delayed supply convert a margin problem into a churn problem and forfeit the right to the renewal
dominance_rules.trigger: a device or account is identified as unprofitable during the term
dominance_rules.action: act through kit, swap, redeployment or an openly negotiated review at a contractual point, and never through undisclosed changes to rates or service

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile the register against the signed schedules before building the expiration calendar
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a renewal queue keyed to remembered dates that misses notice deadlines and has to be rebuilt after the first automatic roll

anti_rework_rules.rule: Prove meter collection on every serial before the first billing cycle rather than after the first dispute
anti_rework_rules.prevents: months of estimated invoices that must be trued up, credited and explained across a whole site

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record a dated final read and swap documentation before any device moves
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unreconstructable counter reset and a ghost invoice on equipment that has already left the building

anti_rework_rules.rule: Rebuild delivered cost per page from actual shipments, parts and labour before proposing any renewal rate
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a next term priced below the account's known service cost, which is repaid as service quality and disputes later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Send the escalator notice a cycle before the uplifted invoice
anti_rework_rules.prevents: credits, an argument and a damaged account for revenue the agreement already entitled the dealer to

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the decision-maker and notice recipient at every account review rather than at the deadline
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reminders delivered to departed contacts and rolls that then have to be unwound with the funder

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the funder's written payoff figure before any upgrade conversation begins
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a proposal rebuilt and re-presented when the real remaining obligation lands, and the credibility lost in between

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read return requirements, accessory lists and destinations at the option-analysis stage, not at pickup
anti_rework_rules.prevents: condition and missing-item charges that surface after a customer was told the return was free

anti_rework_rules.rule: Suspend replenishment for any serial with a scheduled disposition
anti_rework_rules.prevents: consumables shipped into a device that is about to leave and stock written off at the end of the term

anti_rework_rules.rule: Schedule stored-data disposition inside the removal plan when the option is chosen
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a device leaving with customer images and credentials, which no later process can undo

iteration_protocol.trigger: realized margin on a device or model family drops out of its established band
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the margin from actuals, test coverage and colour mix drift, check calls per thousand clicks and shipment-to-click reconciliation, then apply a remedy inside the agreement

iteration_protocol.trigger: a meter collection gap or counter reset is detected on any serial
iteration_protocol.action: restore or replace the collection path, reconstruct the affected periods, true up estimates and re-issue corrected invoices with an explanation

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same dispute root-cause class appears on more than one account
iteration_protocol.action: treat it as a structural defect: correct device profiles, contract wording or invoice presentation at source and verify non-recurrence

iteration_protocol.trigger: a churn signal fires on an account, including an inbound competitive assessment or a change of decision-maker
iteration_protocol.action: run a service recovery and evidence review, meet the new contact, and bring the option review forward into the long-lead band

iteration_protocol.trigger: term ends concentrate in a period beyond the team's capacity to work them properly
iteration_protocol.action: start long-lead reviews earlier and re-sequence the queue rather than compressing or skipping notice-critical steps

iteration_protocol.trigger: a notice reminder fails to reach a decision-maker or an agreement rolls without one
iteration_protocol.action: verify contacts, re-send with acknowledgement required, pursue a good-faith unwind with the funder, and fix the delivery process that failed

iteration_protocol.trigger: volume or mix moves materially after a renewal proposal is built
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the option analysis and re-rate from the corrected history before signature, restating the comparison to the customer

iteration_protocol.trigger: automatic-renewal, data-protection or sector confidentiality rules change in a jurisdiction the base operates in
iteration_protocol.action: re-check the named obligation classes, update the reminder and turnover procedures and the customer-facing records, and flag agreements needing fresh notice

iteration_protocol.trigger: a renewal is recorded complete with elements of the closing set missing
iteration_protocol.action: reopen it, complete the missing element, and tighten the gate that let it pass

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because nothing downstream is decidable until the dealer knows which streams it owns, which serial belongs to which agreement, and what it owes the customer in disclosure; billing integrity follows immediately because the meter is the quantity every later number is built from and a broken read poisons margin analysis, disputes and renewal evidence alike; the economics layer then converts contracted rates into realized margin through coverage, consumable flow and dispatch cost so that device-level decisions rest on rebuilt actuals rather than on quoted assumptions; retention work sits between economics and renewal because uptime and churn signals decide the term end months before the calendar reaches it; the renewal engine - calendar, notice duty, option analysis, evidence-led re-rating, rollover disclosure and conduct - runs last among the operational layers because each of its steps consumes the evidence the earlier layers produced; and offboarding and governance close the loop by making device removal, data turnover, portfolio reading and the closing handoff the acts that start the next cycle with clean records.
